title: The secret readiness test, 10 to 30 October 1969
zeroNote: H-hour is midnight Washington time at the start of 10 October 1969, the day Wheeler notified the commanders; times are days from it

steps.text: JCS CHAIRMAN WHEELER TO THE COMMANDERS: "TEST OUR MILITARY READINESS ... TO RESPOND TO POSSIBLE CONFRONTATION BY THE SOVIET UNION"
steps.source: NSA EBB 81, Nixon's Nuclear Ploy (Burr and Kimball, 2002), doc. of 10 October 1969

steps.text: MEASURES BEGIN: TRAINING FLIGHTS STOOD DOWN · COMMUNICATIONS SILENCE (EMCON) · DEGRADED ALERT SORTIES REINSTATED · POLARIS DEPLOYMENTS TO THE MAXIMUM
steps.source: NSA EBB 81; Sagan and Suri, "The Madman Nuclear Alert," International Security 27:4 (2003): the measures ran from 13 October

steps.text: NAVAL MOVEMENTS: GULF OF ADEN · MEDITERRANEAN · ATLANTIC · SEA OF JAPAN · THE SOVIET NAVY NOTICES THE SHIPS IN THE GULF OF ADEN
KISSINGER TO HALDEMAN: "ALL SORTS OF SIGNAL-TYPE ACTIVITY GOING AROUND THE WORLD TO TRY TO JAR SOVIETS + NVN"
SAC ORDERED TO PREPARE AIRBORNE ALERT OPERATIONS
GIANT LANCE: NUCLEAR-ARMED B-52s OF THE 92ND STRATEGIC AEROSPACE WING FLY THE EIELSON EAST ORBIT OVER ALASKA · EIGHTEEN AIRCRAFT IN SORTIES OF SIX · EIGHTEEN-HOUR VIGILS · DESIGNED TO BE SEEN
steps.source: NSA EBB 81: implementation from 26 October, 92nd Strategic Aerospace Wing, the "Eielson East SEAGA orbit"; Wikipedia, Operation Giant Lance: eighteen B-52s in sorties of six, eighteen-hour vigils

steps.text: EARLY MORNING: RETURN TO NORMAL OPERATIONS · NO SOVIET STRATEGIC RESPONSE OBSERVED · MOSCOW GAVE NO SIGN OF HAVING READ THE SIGNAL AS INTENDED
steps.source: NSA EBB 81, 30 October 1969; Sagan and Suri 2003 on the absence of a Soviet response

bases.name: Castle AFB · 93rd Bombardment Wing
bases.source: Wikipedia, Operation Giant Lance: bases in California and Washington State; the California wing is not named

orbit.name: Eielson East orbit
orbit.source: The orbit is named in the record; its box east of Eielson AFB is drawn from the name and the aircraft's endurance

sources: National Security Archive EBB 81, Nixon's Nuclear Ploy (Burr and Kimball, 2002)
